title: Which virtue of the date palm shall I praise?
odia:
ଖଜୁରୀ ଗଛର କି ଗୁଣ ଗାଇବି
ସେତ ମୂଳରୁ ପାହାଚ ପାହାଚ।
literal_meaning: What virtue of the date palm shall I sing? From its very base, it is step after step.
meaning_odia: ଯାହାର ସବୁଆଡ଼େ ଦୋଷ ଭରି ରହିଛି, ସେଥିରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଦୋଷ ବାଛି କହିବାର ଅର୍ଥ ନାହିଁ—ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏହିପରି। ଗୁଣ ଗାଇବାର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଏଠାରେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ; ମୂଳରୁ ପାହାଚ ପାହାଚର ଛବିରେ ଦୋଷର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଦିଶେ।
explanation: The opening offers praise in form, but the inspected gloss makes it ironic. When faults run throughout something, selecting just one is beside the point. The repeated steps give the criticism a sense of one problem following another from the very beginning.
usage_example: A draft plan has problems in its assumptions, costs and schedule. A reviewer quotes the saying to explain why changing one small detail will not address the whole. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The verse pictures the date palm as marked with steps from its base. Repeating ପାହାଚ makes that succession audible; the source gloss turns it into an image of pervasive faults, while the question about virtues supplies the irony.

english_summary: When faults are everywhere, singling out one misses the extent of the problem.
